title: Circuit fanin bounded by list maximum
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $c$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables, and let $cs$ be a list of such circuits. If $c$ occurs in $cs$, then the maximum fanin of $c$ is at most the maximum fanin aggregated over $cs$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables
$cs$ is a list of Boolean circuits on $n$ variables
